Exercise: Side Leg Raises

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
None

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- unilateral_hip_abduction
- adduction

Primary Muscles:

- adductors

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:

- bodyweight

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
low to moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- improving_hip_mobility
- strengthening_the_adductors_and_hip_abductors

Contraindications:

- Lower back pain
- Hip joint instability

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Clamshell Exercise, equipment: body only

Instructions:

- Stand next to a chair, which you may hold onto as a support. Stand on one leg. This will be your starting position.
- Keeping your leg straight, raise it as far out to the side as possible, and swing it back down, allowing it to cross the opposite leg.
- Repeat this swinging motion 5-10 times, increasing the range of motion as you do so.
